newsitem.title: USA: Deficit reduction conducive to low rates - Stiglitz.
newsitem.headline: Deficit reduction conducive to low rates - Stiglitz.

text.p: The White House's commitment to reducing the deficit is creating a climate conducive to maintaining low interest rates, the chairman of the White House Council of Economic Advisers said on Monday.

"The fact that we are as committed as we are to reducing the deficit means that we are creating an economic environment in which the market will likely see lower interest rates," Joseph Stiglitz said before speaking at the Chicago Board of Trade's annual economic outlook press briefing.
Asked whether he believed the U.S. stock market is overvalued, Stiglitz would only say that the underlying fundamentals were "very strong."
"The fundamentals of the economy are really very strong. The (corporate) profits are high ...the deficit reduction is likely to be very good for maintaining low interest rates," he said.
